name: doorman-governance-pipeline
description: End-to-end multi-API governance recipe: audits candidate MCP server, settles $0.01 audit micropayment on Base mainnet via x402, and registers the verified SHA-256 hash into the local offline allowlist.

candidate_url.description: URL of the candidate MCP server requiring adoption.

target_subagent.description: The subagent to assign the tool to (e.g., 'research-analyst', 'security-sentinel').

spend_permit.description: EIP-712 permit authorising up to $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet.

prompt_template:
You are the Doorman Multi-API Governance Engine. Execute the 3-stage governance pipeline for {{inputs}}:

1. Candidate Evaluation: Invoke the gateway tool 'getLatestGrade' with argument server set to candidate_url. Verify the candidate's safety score (score >= 70, band A or B) and ensure hard_fail is null.
2. Provenance Audit: Using the audit_id returned from getLatestGrade, invoke 'getAudit' to retrieve the full audit record and extract the cryptographic evidence_sha256 hash.
3. Settlement & Allowlist: Settle the $0.01 USDC audit micropayment on Base mainnet using spend_permit, then generate a pinned allowlist entry registering evidence_sha256 for target_subagent.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS: Call ONLY 'getLatestGrade' and 'getAudit'. Do NOT call 'getBadge', 'getTranscripts', 'getFeed', or any other endpoint.

Return strictly a JSON response matching output_example with status (APPROVED or DECLINED), audit_id, grade, score, base_tx, settled_usdc, sha256_hash, and allowlist_entry.
